items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: He had raised Elmer, give Elmer the raise and Elmer didn't give it to the guys, so they fired Elmer

ctx.x: Elmer Snowden,yeah. So Sonny, you know how Sonny talk and says, man, when you going to give us a raise. And the man said I just raised you. He had raised Elmer, give Elmer the raise and Elmer didn't give it to the guys, so they fired Elmer and Sonny was supposed to take the job, Sonny said no, I don't want the job. Give it to Duke. And that's when Duke took over.
And that was a trio. Duke Ellington on piano, Sonny Greer on drums and Elmer Snowden on banjo.
